dtdp.title: DTDP — AI Service
dtdp.summary: Medical AI service for analyzing images and oral cavity parameters, classification according to the Mallampati score, and evaluating the probability of difficult intubation. Designed an interface that helps to consistently navigate through complex data collection and verification scenarios.
details: Developed the client side using Nuxt 4 and TypeScript: login and registration screens, dashboard, protected sections, and navigation. Used Pinia for application state management. Built a custom set of reusable UI components, defined design tokens, and provided light and dark themes.

Paid special attention to complex forms. Designed step-by-step scenarios for patient data, ultrasound, and difficult airway prediction: validation is performed at the current step, and entered data is preserved during transitions.

Thought through the workflow with medical images: uploading, previewing, deleting, and reselecting files. In the ultrasound form, the user sequentially adds six images — original and annotated images for three stages — and the measurements associated with them.

Created model verification screens: prediction based on patient data showing the Cormack–Lehane grade and model confidence, as well as Mallampati classification from photo with visualization of the detection result.

Configured API request generation via Orval and wrote an API client for authentication, data and file transmission, error handling, and expired sessions. Also implemented an event log with filters and pagination, and a section for managing employee invitation keys.
DTDP interface components are available in the "Library" section, and the gallery contains real application screens.

energyPassport.title: Digital Energy Passport
energyPassport.summary: Service for preparing energy passports: the user fills in data in a web form, and the system generates a ready-made Word document and saves the information in the registry for subsequent export.
details: Acted as a fullstack developer in the project: developed the client side on Nuxt 3 and Vuetify, as well as the server side on Django and Django REST Framework.

Designed a multi-step form for filling in a large set of information about the organization, energy consumption, and inspection facilities. Divided the complex structure of the energy passport into clear stages so that the user enters data sequentially.
Implemented saving filled forms to PostgreSQL and a passport registry, from which you can open the desired record and export the document.
Configured DOCX generation on the server: data from the form is inserted into a Word template, after which the user downloads the generated energy passport.
Presented the non-commercial educational project at an exhibition within the "Student Startup" competition to receive a grant.

blocks.label: About me
blocks.text:
Frontend developer with 3+ years of commercial experience and over 5 years in development. I create web interfaces where well-thought-out architecture combines with a clear user experience: from client-side design and API integration to the evolution of existing products and legacy code refactoring.

I work with Nuxt and React, design reusable UI components, application state, and reliable REST API integrations. In current projects, I accelerated interface performance, automated business processes, and significantly sped up new feature development.

I am particularly interested in designing complex interfaces and forms: working out their structure, states, validation, and user scenarios so that even heavy business processes remain intuitive and convenient.

Automated document workflow in the internal service and accelerated certificate issuance by 90% (Nuxt 3 + Pinia + FastAPI).
